description: Header file defining structures, function prototypes, and macros for repository pack management, including packing, repacking, and pack geometry operations.

classes.name: pack_objects_args
classes.description: Structure holding arguments for packing objects, including window, depth, threading, size limits, and filter options.

classes.name: child_process
classes.description: Forward declaration for a structure representing a child process.

classes.name: write_pack_opts
classes.description: Options for writing a pack, including arguments, destination, and directory paths.

classes.name: repository
classes.description: Forward declaration for a repository structure.

classes.name: packed_git
classes.description: Forward declaration for a packed_git structure.

classes.name: existing_packs
classes.description: Structure managing collections of pack files, including kept, non-kept, cruft, and index packs.

classes.name: generated_pack
classes.description: Forward declaration for a generated pack structure.

classes.name: pack_geometry
classes.description: Structure representing the geometry of packs, including pack array, count, split info, and split factor.

classes.name: tempfile
classes.description: Forward declaration for a temporary file structure.

classes.name: repack_write_midx_opts
classes.description: Options for writing multi-pack index (midx), including existing packs, geometry, and progress options.

methods.name: prepare_pack_objects
methods.description: Prepares pack objects with specified arguments and output.

methods.name: pack_objects_args_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with pack objects arguments.

methods.name: repack_remove_redundant_pack
methods.description: Removes redundant pack files from a repository.

methods.name: write_pack_opts_pack_prefix
methods.description: Returns the pack prefix string based on write pack options.

methods.name: write_pack_opts_is_local
methods.description: Checks if the write pack options specify a local pack.

methods.name: finish_pack_objects_cmd
methods.description: Completes the pack objects command with specified algorithm, options, and command process.

methods.name: existing_packs_collect
methods.description: Collects pack files into existing packs, categorizing kept and non-kept packs.

methods.name: existing_packs_has_non_kept
methods.description: Checks if there are non-kept packs.

methods.name: existing_pack_is_marked_for_deletion
methods.description: Determines if a pack is marked for deletion.

methods.name: existing_packs_retain_cruft
methods.description: Retains cruft packs in the existing packs collection.

methods.name: existing_packs_mark_for_deletion
methods.description: Marks specified packs for deletion.

methods.name: existing_packs_remove_redundant
methods.description: Removes redundant packs from the collection.

methods.name: existing_packs_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with existing packs.

methods.name: generated_pack_populate
methods.description: Creates and populates a generated pack.

methods.name: generated_pack_has_ext
methods.description: Checks if a generated pack has a specific extension.

methods.name: generated_pack_install
methods.description: Installs a generated pack into the repository.

methods.name: repack_promisor_objects
methods.description: Repack objects that are promisor objects in the repository.

methods.name: pack_geometry_init
methods.description: Initializes pack geometry based on existing packs and arguments.

methods.name: pack_geometry_split
methods.description: Splits pack geometry into multiple parts.

methods.name: pack_geometry_preferred_pack
methods.description: Returns the preferred pack from the geometry.

methods.name: pack_geometry_remove_redundant
methods.description: Removes redundant packs based on geometry and existing packs.

methods.name: pack_geometry_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with pack geometry.

methods.name: midx_snapshot_refs
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of references for the midx.

methods.name: write_midx_included_packs
methods.description: Writes included packs into the midx.

methods.name: write_filtered_pack
methods.description: Writes a filtered pack based on options and existing packs.

methods.name: write_cruft_pack
methods.description: Writes a cruft pack with specified expiration and size.
